summary: Rockstar lists November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Its support page says both release at midnight local time in all regions.

On November 9, Take-Two’s CEO said the launch was ten days away. The company reiterated its fiscal 2027 net bookings outlook and reported preorders above initial expectations. This strengthens confidence in the current plan.
The earnings release and call are forward-looking statements from the same financially interested publisher. They do not prove gold status, full certification, or an unchangeable date.
Pre-load is separate from play access: PS5 starts at local midnight November 10; Xbox starts globally at 00:00 GMT November 10. Rockstar says up to 212 GB may be needed depending on device.
Rockstar announced a November 21 Miami music event to celebrate the launch. This is launch marketing, not software-readiness evidence.
Two earlier public targets moved. November 19 remains a commitment, not a guarantee.
No official native PC release or window is listed. GamesBeat’s Q1 2027 report cites four anonymous sources and is not a publisher commitment.
Review-code distribution and a November 18 embargo remain reported, not first-party announcements; they do not prove a final build.
An account using the Cyberleek name has made an unverified full-build claim. GinjFo’s latest inspected update found no new gameplay footage it could authenticate.
uncertainty: The CEO statement and fiscal outlook support Take-Two’s current plan but are forward-looking and commercially interested; they do not establish final build status or eliminate delay risk.
Rockstar has publicly moved release targets twice before; no release date is guaranteed.
The official time rule is midnight local time on each console; specific store metadata can change.
Rockstar says up to 212 GB depending on device; exact per-console storage and day-one patch size remain unknown.
The GamesBeat Q1 2027 PC window remains an anonymous-source report, not an official platform or date.
Review-code distribution and the November 18 embargo remain unofficial reports; no named recipient or public first-party schedule was identified.
The Cyberleek account, operator, and complete-build claim remain unverified; its latest inspected report did not authenticate new footage.
Pool analytics were unavailable; visits, decisions, source checks, returns, and funding were not measured.
freshness_note: Checked November 10, 2026. Take-Two’s November 9 earnings statement says the launch is ten days away and reiterates the fiscal-year outlook. Rockstar still lists November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; this strengthens confidence in the plan, not certainty.
